subject: Post-call: schedule ML/Infra technical handoff (60–90m) and attendee roles
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@kestrel.ai>, Daniel Kim <daniel.k@kestrel.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + request: schedule ML/Infra technical handoff (60-90m)

Hi Sophie / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and some clear alignment on latency targets and data isolation needs. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: validate inference latency and throughput for your annotation pipeline (~1k reqs/min, bursty peaks).
- Constraint: isolation required for PII pipelines (would prefer Dedicated or Private options).
- Success criteria: <150ms p95 for 512-token requests on our recommended config; KV cache pattern that preserves session context.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical handoff with our ML/Infra engineers to walk through the proposed architecture, run a short perf profile plan, and lock attendee roles. Suggested attendees from our side: myself (Sales), Monica (Solutions Engineer), and Ben (SRE/Infra). Would you please confirm who from Kestrel should join? We typically find it useful to include: an ML lead, an SRE/infra lead, and the primary PM.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Aug 12, 09:00–10:30
- Fri Aug 13, 13:00–14:30

If none of those work, please pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-ml-infra (I can extend to 90m if you need more time).

I've attached a one-page draft agenda and the discovery notes from today's call for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood-technical-agenda-v1.docx (docx, 1 page), kestrel-discovery-notes.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@kestrel.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.k@kestrel.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request: schedule ML/Infra technical handoff (60-90m)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the crisp recap. Daniel and I reviewed the slots, and Thursday Aug 12 at 09:00 PST works best for us.

Attendees from Kestrel:
- Sophie Turner, Head of ML (sophie@kestrel.ai)
- Daniel Kim, Platform Lead (daniel.k@kestrel.ai)
- Nina Park, PM (nina.park@kestrel.ai) — I cc'd her on a separate thread and she'll accept the invite shortly.

Couple quick asks for the session:
1) Could you include an SRE who can speak to instance sizing and autoscaling behavior under burst?
2) If possible, add a 10–15 minute slot to review data retention/audit logging options (we have strict retention rules).

We confirmed the Calendly slot. Please send a calendar invite with the agenda and any pre-reads we should review.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Turner
Head of ML, Kestrel AI
sophie@kestrel.ai

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request: schedule ML/Infra technical handoff (60-90m)

Perfect — thanks Sophie. I've locked Thu Aug 12, 09:00–10:30 PST on our side and sent a calendar invite to everyone on this thread.

Quick notes for the invite / agenda:
- 09:00–09:10 Introductions & goals (Marcus)
- 09:10–09:35 Architecture walkthrough / sizing assumptions (Ben)
- 09:35–09:55 Performance profiling plan + KV cache patterns (Monica)
- 09:55–10:10 Data isolation & retention / audit logging options (Ben + Monica)
- 10:10–10:20 Open questions & next steps (all)

I've attached the agenda as a 1-page doc (redwood-technical-agenda-v1.docx) and included our discovery notes (kestrel-discovery-notes.pdf). Please flag anything you'd like rearranged. We'll make sure Ben is prepared to discuss instance types and autoscaling policy (including fallback to Dedicated capacity).

If you have any pre-reads or sample traces you'd like us to look at before the call, drop them in the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tdx-prep

See you Thursday — Marcus

Marcus / Monica —

Thanks for including me on the session. I'll prepare instance sizing numbers for the 3 configurations we discussed (gpus per replica, baseline threads, expected p95 estimates) and a short slide with autoscaling knobs. Also adding a short checklist to the Drive folder for pre-call traces / sample payloads we should ask Kestrel to upload.

Drive prep doc: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tdx-prep

If you want me to run a quick internal smoke test beforehand, suggest we schedule 30 minutes on Wed afternoon — otherwise I can just come with the numbers.

— Ben
